product.title: Blue Mountains Day Tour Including Parramatta River Cruise

description.text: In Sydney, this full-day coach outing combines a Parramatta River cruise with Blue Mountains time at Scenic World and the Three Sisters. The published route leaves from Central Station on Eddy Avenue rather than a private harbour half-day. The public page lists a long day covering river and plateau stops in one booking. The format suits visitors who want a combined river-and-mountains day without assembling separate cruise and coach tickets. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Sydney, and the itinerary stays on Parramatta River, the Blue Mountains, Scenic World, and the Three Sisters that define this outing rather than a Port Stephens sand-dune day.

start.description: Meet at Central Station, Eddy Avenue, Sydney.

end.description: Return to the Sydney meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
